de: Italy declares war on the Ottoman Empire, In this war , Italy gains Libya which ends Ottoman rule in North Africa .

t: 一次意外的炸弹爆炸引发了反清的武昌起义，辛亥革命开始。

de: The day after a bomb explodes prematurely, the Wuchang Uprising begins against the Chinese monarchy.
